title: Atrinik
description: Atrinik is an open-source role-playing world with a human-authorship policy for creative game content and primarily Codex-driven software development, with human code contributions welcome.

identity.heading: Human creativity at the heart of the world. Agent-driven software beneath it.
identity.gameContent: Atrinik's policy reserves creative game content for people: generative AI is not accepted for new or modified maps, pixel art, music, sound effects, quests, dialogue, or lore. Repository owners are auditing the existing corpus before making a blanket authorship claim.
identity.software: Software is developed primarily through Codex-driven agentic workflows under human direction, review, provenance, and validation. Direct human code contributions are welcome under the same gates.
identity.websiteMediaException: Until the temporary concept artwork is replaced, this game-content policy does not describe every image on atrinik.org; the four generated website images remain explicitly recorded and credited.
